title: Giant OREO Cookie Cake
description: This giant-sized Oreo cookie recipe includes devil's food cake mix, semisweet chocolate chips, cream cheese, frozen whipped topping, and Oreo cookies.
ingredients: 1 package (2-layer size) devil's food cake mix

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Coat two 9-inch round cake pans with cooking spray.

Combine cake mix, water, eggs, and vegetable oil in a large bowl; beat with an electric mixer on low speed until moistened. Increase speed to medium and beat for 2 minutes. Pour batter into the prepared cake pans.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean, 24 to 29 minutes. Cool cakes in the pans for 10 minutes; invert carefully onto wire racks. Cool cakes completely.
Place chocolate and butter in a small microwave-safe bowl; microwave on high power until butter is melted, about 2 minutes. Stir until chocolate is completely melted; cool 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, beat cream cheese and sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer until combined; gently stir in whipped topping and crushed cookies.

Place 1 cake layer on a plate; top with cream cheese mixture. Place remaining cake layer on cream cheese mixture layer; spread with chocolate glaze. Let stand until firm, 10 minutes. Store in the refrigerator.
